name: lexbench
author: OberynKC <kangchen.1019@gmail.com>
description: 面向中国执业律师的个人工作台 · 本地数据优先

scripts.dev:electron: wait-on http://localhost:5173 && npm run electron:build && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron .
scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && npm run electron:build
scripts.setup: npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund && node node_modules/electron/install.js && npm run rebuild:native
scripts.smoke:db: esbuild scripts/smoke-db.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:better-sqlite3 --outdir=dist-electron --out-extension:.js=.cjs && cross-env ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 electron dist-electron/smoke-db.cjs
scripts.smoke:export: esbuild scripts/smoke-export.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:better-sqlite3 --external:exceljs --external:archiver --external:jszip --outfile=dist-electron/export-smoke.cjs && cross-env ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 electron dist-electron/export-smoke.cjs
scripts.smoke:ipc: esbuild scripts/smoke-ipc.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --alias:electron=./scripts/fixtures/electron.ts --external:better-sqlite3 --external:exceljs --external:archiver --external:jszip --outfile=dist-electron/ipc-smoke.cjs && cross-env ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 electron dist-electron/ipc-smoke.cjs
scripts.smoke:backup: esbuild scripts/smoke-backup.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --alias:electron=./scripts/fixtures/electron.ts --external:better-sqlite3 --external:exceljs --external:archiver --external:jszip --outfile=dist-electron/backup-smoke.cjs && cross-env ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 electron dist-electron/backup-smoke.cjs
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && node scripts/package.cjs mac && npm run verify:package && npm run release:metadata
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && node scripts/package.cjs win && npm run verify:package && npm run release:metadata
